title: Doctor name printed as "Dr. Dr. …" in conflict errors and audit entries
foundIn: System testing (UI walkthrough of booking a taken slot)
steps: Book an appointment in a slot that is already taken for Dr. Arjun Sharma.
expected: Message: "Dr. Arjun Sharma already has an appointment at …"
actual: Message: "Dr. Dr. Arjun Sharma already has an appointment at …" (same in audit log summaries).
rootCause: Service prefixed "Dr." to full_name, which already contains the title.
fix: Removed the extra prefix in appointmentService and queueService.

title: Payment receipt shows the invoice's current balance instead of the balance after that payment
foundIn: System testing (reprinting the first receipt of an invoice paid in two instalments)
steps: Pay ₹100 of an ₹900 invoice, then pay the remaining ₹800, then print the first receipt.
expected: First receipt shows balance after payment ₹800.00.
actual: First receipt shows balance ₹0.00 (uses the invoice's latest paid amount).
fix: Balance is now total − SUM(payments with id ≤ this payment).

title: Invoice list ordered by internal id rather than invoice date
steps: Open Billing → Invoices after loading demo data.
actual: Older invoices created later in the seed appeared first.
fix: ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC.

title: Clicking a form label toggles the first payment-method / working-day button
steps: Open Record payment, select UPI, then click on the "Payment method" label text.
actual: Selection jumps to CASH because the buttons were nested inside a <label> element.
rootCause: Button group wrapped by the shared Field component, which renders a <label>.
fix: Button groups use a plain caption and role=radio / aria-pressed buttons.

title: Transferring a patient on the day of admission bills two minimum bed-days
foundIn: System testing (admit → transfer after a few minutes → request discharge)
steps: Admit to General Ward A (₹1,500/day), transfer to General Ward B after 10 minutes, request discharge 5 hours later.
actual: 2 bed-days charged (₹3,000): each bed stay applied its own 1-day minimum.
rootCause: bedCharges() applied max(1, ceil(h/24)) per stay instead of per admission.
fix: Admission is billed max(1, ceil(totalHours/24)) days, shared across stays by largest-remainder allocation; zero-day stays are not charged.

title: Demo data gives one patient two tokens with the same doctor on the same day
foundIn: System testing (Queue board shows P00017 with tokens #04 and #05)
steps: Load demo data, open Dr. Sharma's queue board.
expected: A patient appears at most once per doctor per day.
actual: The same patient appeared twice in the queue.
rootCause: Seeder only prevented identical time slots, not repeat visits to the same doctor.

title: Laboratory status counters ignore the doctor's "My orders" filter
foundIn: System testing (doctor view of Laboratory page)
steps: Log in as a doctor, open Laboratory, keep "My orders" selected.
expected: Tab counts reflect only the doctor's orders.
fix: /lab/stats accepts doctorId; page passes it when "My orders" is selected.

title: Patient picker in the Admit dialog does not flag patients who are already admitted
steps: Open Admit patient and search for a patient who is currently admitted.
expected: Picker marks the patient as already admitted.
actual: Patient can be selected; the server then correctly rejects the admission with "already admitted" (FR-39 is still enforced).
rootCause: Picker does not query active admissions (usability enhancement).
fix: Deferred to next release – business rule is enforced server-side and covered by IT-IPD-02.
